meta.case: Pipeline, Oahu, regular swell on the 310 deg line (illustrative, not a forecast; 2D slice)
meta.label: illustrative, not a forecast (2D slice)
meta.frame_origin: x_m east / y_m north of 21.665 N, -158.0515 E (M_PER_DEG 111195), as pipeline.json

fields.s_cm: distance from the house along the bearing (cm); first frame absolute
fields.ds_cm: change of s_cm since the previous frame (cm); later frames
fields.z_cm: height above LMSL (cm); first frame absolute
fields.dz_cm: change of z_cm since previous frame
fields.surface_cm: free surface height above LMSL (cm) every 1 m of surface_s_m; null where dry

notes: 2013 lidar, 8 m cells; the reef's fine structure is not resolved.
2D simulation (WCSPH) on one line through the lidar (grid, interpolated between cells); no refraction or alongshore variation
particles are a thin band at the free surface (overturning lips included), the same number in every 1 m of s; index j stays in the same 1 m bin, but is not the same particle between frames
profile position uncertain by about one grid cell (9-12 m)
meta.profile_origin_note: 'house' = profile origin, 60 m landward of the shoreline on the line (no house at this spot); s = 60 m is the shoreline at this tide
meta.sat_here_note: sat_here_user_s_m = approximate take-off (not a user mark at this spot)
